name: Good Golly He's Gully
description: Thugged-out beach bum seagull with sunglasses, gold chain with illuminati pyramid eye pendant, holding rum and coke, and slowly smoking a joint
author: Jeopardish Project

accessories: thick gold chain with illuminati pyramid eye pendant
character.personality: beach bum, laid-back, slightly disheveled, confident smirk, bloodshot eyes behind sunglasses

idle.description: Relaxed standing pose, sunglasses on, subtle smoking wisps, occasionally sipping drink

working.description: More dynamic pose, wings slightly raised, active smoking, looking around faster

needs_input.description: Leaning forward, sunglasses pushed down showing bloodshot eyes, joint prominent, waiting for user

blocked.description: Drooped wings, disgruntled expression, joint gone out, chain hanging loose, frustrated

success.description: Celebratory pose, wings spread, toast with rum and coke, triumphant expression

smoking.cycle: slow smoke wisps rising, joint periodically goes out, new joint rolled and lit

drinking.cycle: occasional sips from rum and coke

sunglasses.action: occasionally peaks over sunglasses with bloodshot eyes and smirk
sunglasses.timing: random during idle and working states

technical.transparency: unused cells should be fully transparent

attribution: Based on Jeopardish aesthetic and provided seagull sprite references
notes: Character inspired by Really Long Beach seagull - thugged-out beach bum aesthetic with sunglasses, gold chain, and beach party vibes
